reason: Confirmed with qualifications (local Win32_Process read at 20:39Z, no Kaggle calls). (a) PID 23464, the 01:30Z timer, reads verbatim 'send it (CI only until 01:45 UTC), log LATE'. That text is stale. CONTEXT l.3707 (10:47Z) replaced the old 'non-CI only after 02:00Z' rule, and W4 = 00:05-01:45Z applies to all files (l.3163, and l.3840 for the 40-min non-CI spacing). So a missing non-CI file (exp89q/exp89p) may go at 01:30Z. (b) This part is overstated. The 00:44Z text (PID 4732) is 'submit exp89p at 00:46 UTC (>= 40 min after the non-CI stack) if not yet sent', so it already carries the spacing rule; only the fixed '00:46' is stale. The 00:50Z text says 'due 00:46 UTC' but sends 'with the freeze-line guards', and those guards include T54 in item (4). The conflict is real only if exp89q is sent after 00:06Z (nb_try backoff of up to 20 min). (c) Confirmed: 0 processes carry the ': WAITER_' tag, so the R28-A4 (vii) tag count would read 0. The finding adds no new action. It duplicates scan_plancheck PC29-07 (the same 01:30Z conflict), and the stated action is already written: night_checklist.md section 5 [R29] (T54 recompute, any due file until 01:45Z, LATE after), freeze template item (8) (timer.sh count) and item (10) (all timers follow the checklist, with its sha8). Value is operational only. It matters only if both the 00:04Z batch and nb_try's 10-min section-N loop fail. Even then a non-CI file skipped at 01:30Z still goes at the 06:07Z post-wake step (read ~13:10Z, before the 20:00Z tick and the 11:30Z cutoff). Feasible, zero-cost, within R1-R10, and it touches no model file.
fix: Nothing new to build. At the 23:33Z freeze: (1) log item (10) with the checklist sha8 and one explicit clause: 'timer message texts are triggers only; the 01:30Z "CI only until 01:45" and the 00:44/00:50Z "00:46" are superseded by checklist section 4/5 (T54 = max(00:46Z, exp89q actual + 40 min); any missing due file until 01:45Z; LATE after)'. (2) Log item (8) as the timer.sh count, never the WAITER_ tag count (tag count = 0). (3) Do not re-arm: killing and restarting timers adds failure modes for no gain, since each timer points to the freeze line and checklist. (4) Merge with PC29-07 in the round report, so the missing LATE check between 01:30Z and 06:07Z is decided once (for example, the 02:13Z hourly-round handler first runs checklist section 5).
realistic_gain: 0 on score. It is a small ops-risk reduction: it avoids skipping a non-CI night file at 01:30Z, or sending exp89p less than 40 min after a slipped exp89q. This matters only in a double-failure night (batch plus its retry loop), probability roughly < 5%, and even then the file still goes at 06:07Z and reads before the tick. The action is already implemented in night_checklist.md section 5 and freeze template items (8) and (10).
